topic: The lift of an old city building stops at a floor that does not exist in the building plan.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Floor That Wasn't There

shots.narration: The building had three floors; the lift found a fourth.
shots.scene: Old Pakistani haveli courtyard at midnight, brass lantern between two wooden chairs, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no visible text.
shots.action: Bashir raises four fingers toward Saad.
shots.mood: Warm lantern glow beneath cold moonlight, deep shadows around the courtyard.

shots.narration: Bashir began his story beside the lantern.
shots.scene: Same haveli courtyard, Bashir in a brown woollen shawl and white cap opposite Saad in a dark green hoodie.
shots.mood: Intimate amber light, silent darkness beyond the chairs.

shots.narration: [whispers] The caretaker's plan showed only three floors.
shots.scene: Flashback inside an old Pakistani city building, dusty table beside an antique lift, unlettered architectural drawing showing exactly three stacked levels.
shots.action: Bashir traces the drawing's topmost floor with one finger.
shots.mood: Pale moonlight across paper, lantern reflections on tarnished brass.

shots.narration: I took the lift to check the roof.
shots.scene: Antique wooden lift cabin with an unmarked brass button, blank walls, Bashir holding his old lantern.
shots.mood: Cramped amber interior, heavy shadows above his white cap.

shots.narration: But it climbed beyond the rooftop.
shots.scene: Exterior cutaway of the same three-storey building, lift shaft extending impossibly above the roof into fog, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: The illuminated lift cabin rises above the rooftop.
shots.mood: Cold blue moonlight, unnatural architecture disappearing into black mist.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then its doors opened onto a silent corridor.
shots.scene: Lift interior facing a long abandoned corridor with peeling plaster and identical closed doors, no markings.
shots.action: The lift doors slide apart before Bashir.
shots.mood: Lantern light spilling into a corridor with no visible end.

shots.narration: At the end stood another lantern, exactly like mine.
shots.scene: View past Bashir inside the lift toward a matching brass lantern resting at the corridor's distant end.
shots.mood: Two isolated amber lights surrounded by thick, bluish darkness.

shots.narration: Its shadow stretched toward me, against the light.
shots.scene: Low corridor view with the distant lantern and Bashir framed inside the open lift.
shots.action: The distant lantern's shadow stretches across the floor toward Bashir.
shots.mood: An impossibly long black shape crossing warm pools of light.

shots.narration: [whispers] I shut the doors before that shadow reached my feet.
shots.scene: Inside the antique lift, a narrow opening onto the corridor, black shadow close to the threshold.
shots.action: Bashir drags the folding lift gate shut.
shots.mood: Tight framing, trembling lantern glow, darkness pressed against the gate.

shots.narration: Back home, Saad noticed something behind my chair.
shots.scene: Present-night haveli courtyard, lantern between the chairs, an antique lift door now embedded in the previously bare wall.
shots.mood: Familiar warm courtyard light disturbed by a cold metallic doorway.

shots.narration: The doors opened, and that shadow reached for our lantern.
shots.scene: Haveli courtyard facing the open impossible lift, empty black cabin behind its doors.
shots.action: A long finger-shaped shadow creeps from the lift toward their lantern.
shots.mood: Deepest darkness of the episode, amber light nearly swallowed by the approaching

shots.narration: [whispers] Beyond it waited a railway platform beneath our house.
shots.scene: View over Saad's shoulder through the impossible lift doorway onto a foggy underground railway platform, empty bench, no signs or lettering.
shots.action: Saad directs his small torch through the doorway.
shots.mood: Narrow white beam revealing wet platform tiles and rails vanishing into mist.

episode.endHook: Next night: the lift opens onto a railway station underground.
episode.description: By lantern light, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about an old city lift that stopped at an impossible floor. Some doors should never open twice. A fictional spooky story set in Pakistan.
